title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1978-04-08
source: 7" Betty Board Reel @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES > Fostex D5 > optical S/PDIF out (Jace's tape) > disk

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Betty soundboard captures a mellow, floating performance that fans rave about.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers praise both the music and the fidelity of this recording, calling it hot, clear, and the best Betty board sound ever heard. The show is described as a great, mellow groove that lets listeners float from start to finish, with no noted flaws in either performance or audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic reviews (average 4.67 stars) highlight an outstanding soundboard recording and a superb, consistently grooving show; no negatives were mentioned.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as crystal‑clear, high‑fidelity, "the best Betty board" ever heard, with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth and consistently mellow throughout; reviewers note a relaxed groove that makes the entire concert feel like a floating experience.
